# bump2v

> One command to version any repo: bump2v rewrites the version in every file listed in its config (.bumpversion.cfg), commits, tags and pushes branch and tag together. Zero dependencies beyond Python 3.11+ and git. Works for any language and any CI, and is built to be driven by AI coding agents.

Rules for agents working in a repo that uses bump2v:

- Never edit version numbers by hand; bump2v keeps every file and the config in line.
- Preview: `bump2v plan auto --json` changes nothing and returns the new version, files, commit message and tag as one JSON object.
- Release: `bump2v release auto` (or `patch`, `minor`, `major`) bumps, commits, tags and pushes. `--no-push` keeps it local. A dirty working tree is refused.
- Check: `bump2v check` exits 4 when a file has drifted from current_version.
- Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage, 3 dirty tree, 4 version not found or drift, 5 tag exists, 6 push failed, 7 nothing to release.
- `auto` follows Conventional Commits since the last release: feat is minor, feat! or a BREAKING CHANGE footer is major, anything else is patch.

## Docs

- [Get started](https://maimul.github.io/bump2v/): install, first release, what a release does
- [Your stack](https://maimul.github.io/bump2v/stacks/): config for Node, Python, Rust, Helm, Expo, .NET, Go and plain files
- [GitHub Actions](https://maimul.github.io/bump2v/ci/github-actions/): the Action, its inputs and outputs, pinning, protected branches
- [GitLab CI/CD](https://maimul.github.io/bump2v/ci/gitlab/): the release and check templates, push tokens, BUMP2V_* variables
- [Any other CI](https://maimul.github.io/bump2v/ci/other/): what a release job needs, Bitbucket, the container image
- [AI coding agents](https://maimul.github.io/bump2v/agents/): the Releasing section, permission rules, JSON and exit codes
- [Coming from bump2version](https://maimul.github.io/bump2v/migrate/): same config, and bump2v pushes by default

## Reference

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maimul/bump2v/main/README.md): every command, option, config key, exit code and the JSON output
